title: Assistant Professor
employer: Columbia University in the City of New York, Department of Political Science
description:
Columbia University’s Department of Political Science invites applications for an Assistant Professor position in Political Methodology, to begin July 1, 2027, pending final budgetary approval. Candidates will be expected to sustain an active research and publication agenda and teach in both the undergraduate and graduate programs. 

A Ph.D. in Political Science, Economics, or Statistics is required at the time of appointment. All candidates must demonstrate outstanding scholarship and excellent promise for future development as scholars, instructors, and mentors. Applications must be made through Columbia University's Academic Search and Recruiting (ASR) system here https://apply.interfolio.com/190515. Applicants should submit a cover letter, curriculum vitae, three letters of reference, and at least two article-length writing samples. The Search Committee will begin reviewing applications on October 1, 2026, and the search will remain open until filled.
